output.headline: Adds $3,766 to pay a computer-cart helper at Madison Park Academy, raising the cap to $28,766

money.evidence: in the additional amount of $3,766.00

output.summary: This amendment adds $3,766 to an existing agreement with an individual who helps keep track of the school's computer cart inventory, supports students' in-person technology needs, and disinfects loaner and classroom computers daily. The cap rises from $25,000 to $28,766 for August 10, 2020 through May 28, 2021. The Board is ratifying (approving after the fact) the change, which covers a period that began before this vote.

output.headline: Pays LECR Box LLC up to $3,000 for an online cooking class for parents at Greenleaf Elementary

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $3,000.00

output.summary: LECR Box LLC provided an online cooking class so parents at Greenleaf Elementary School can learn to cook healthy dishes and new techniques for their families. The agreement covers January 4 to May 31, 2021, and pays up to $3,000. The Board is ratifying (approving after the fact) an agreement whose service period began before this vote.

output.headline: Extends the state's $5.9M early literacy grant to June 30, 2024
output.summary: The California Department of Education's Early Literacy Support Block Grant, in the amount of $5,895,906, now runs to June 30, 2024 instead of June 30, 2023. The grant gives schools focused resources to improve early literacy programs and address low literacy rates before 3rd grade. The text describes a time extension; it does not state any added money.

output.headline: Pays a consultant up to $8,700 to coach Life Academy administrators on equity and staff culture

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $8,700.00

output.summary: An individual consultant will provide administrative coaching at Life Academy on equity, social-emotional learning, trauma-informed teaching, restorative practices and healthy staff culture during COVID-19. The agreement runs from April 26 to May 27, 2021, and pays up to $8,700. The Board is ratifying (approving after the fact) the agreement.

output.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $28,000 for an AmeriCorps tutor for newcomer students

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $28,000.00

output.sourceIssueCandidate: Items 21-1175 and 21-1176 describe the same service at the same school for the same period with different amounts ($28,000 and $14,000) and funding sources; they may be one service split across funding sources or a duplicate.
output.summary: Bay Area Community Resources will provide an AmeriCorps staff person at Oakland International High School to give academic support, mentoring and tutoring to newly arrived immigrant students, during and after school. The agreement runs September 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021 and pays up to $28,000. A separate item on the same agenda (21-1176) has near-identical wording with a different amount and funding source.

output.headline: Approves $26.7M in district bills paid in April 2021 (1,062 checks)
output.summary: The Board approves the district's accounts payable payments, meaning 1,062 checks printed to pay vendors and other bills, from April 1 through April 30, 2021. The total is $26,701,025.26. This is a routine monthly report of money already paid out.

output.headline: Approves $19.5M in April 2021 payroll: 701 checks and 6,556 direct deposits
output.summary: The Board approves the district's payroll payments for April 1 through April 30, 2021. This covers 701 printed checks and 6,556 direct deposits, for a total of $19,502,828.96. This is a routine monthly report of payroll already paid.

output.headline: Adopts $3.2M in Measure G1 middle school grants for 2021-22, per the oversight commission's advice

money.evidence: in the cumulative amount of $3,203,307.00

output.summary: This resolution adopts the Measure G1 oversight commission's recommended 2021-2022 grant awards and education spending plans for district middle schools and charter middle schools. The awards total $3,203,307. Measure G1 is a parcel tax for teacher retention and middle school improvement.

output.headline: Adopts resolution adding staff positions for the 2020-21 school year (Position Additions #3)
output.summary: The Board adopts Resolution No. 2021-0214, the third set of new staff positions added in fiscal year 2020-2021. The item text does not list the positions or any dollar amounts.

output.headline: Suspends for one year the rule to present a draft budget and LCAP to the Board in May 2021
output.summary: This resolution suspends, for one year, the Board Policy 3150 requirement that the district present an initial draft of its budget and its Local Control and Accountability Plan (LCAP) to the Board in May 2021. No dollar amount is stated.

output.headline: Ratifies three appointments to the Measures B, J and Y school bond oversight committee
output.summary: The Board is ratifying the Board President's appointment or reappointment of three people to the Measures B, J, and Y Independent Citizens' School Facilities Bond Oversight Committee. Each term runs from June 11, 2021 through June 10, 2023. No dollar amount is stated.

output.summary: This memorandum of understanding (a written agreement) with the American Federation of State, County, and Municipal Employees (AFSCME) covers the impacts and effects of reopening schools for in-person learning and student supports in spring 2021.
